scientific_question: Do the two original wetland camera stations share a differential Water Deer-to-Boar detected-record distribution, or is the pooled forest-versus-wetland association localized to a single wetland camera?

author_source.habitat_roster: nine published forest camera codes G1-G22 and exactly two published wetland codes M1 and M2
author_source.author_released_source_grain: 11 camera×24 clock-hour published count table, no dated events or actual station on-time

roster_and_comparisons.equal_unit_comparison: enumerate all 55 possible unordered two-camera subsets and rank the actual source-defined wetland pair by water-share minus boar-share in full original species record totals
roster_and_comparisons.source_record_fraction_difference: Σwetland_sites(W_site/184−B_site/273), contributions to overall observed wetland record contrast
roster_and_comparisons.excluded_wetland_recompute_rule: When removing one wetland camera, recompute BOTH species' full retained-camera totals before calculating the remaining site share; keep all original forest sites
roster_and_comparisons.formal_photo_label_reference: one-sided exact hypergeometric tail P(X≥110) conditional on 184 Water labels, 273 Boar labels, 184 combined Wetland photos and 273 combined Forest photos
roster_and_comparisons.formal_M2_photo_label_reference: one-sided exact hypergeometric tail P(X≥92) conditional on 184 Water, 273 Boar, 141 M2 photos

interpretation_limit: LOCAL_M2_SOURCE_PHOTO_CONCENTRATION_WITH_HABITAT_CONTEXT; no causal wetland selection, independently replicated habitat effects or valid animal-population p-value
